purpose: Generated visual references, not installed in-game art.
limitations: Illustrative generated views; strict orthographic projection and scale consistency not guaranteed. Sprite is an enlarged pixel-style reference; exact 120px height and palette count have not been verified.
model_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a precise four-view model sheet of the SAME robotic wolf shown in the supplied eight-view sprite sheet. Image 1 is the sole design reference, not a style to redesign. Four separated views in a spacious 2x2 layout: upper left TRUE RIGHT-FACING SIDE elevation (camera perpendicular to side, near legs occlude far legs, no visible front face); upper right TRUE FRONT elevation; lower left TRUE BACK elevation; lower right orthographic front-right three-quarter. All four at equal scale and equal standing height in a consistent neutral four-foot stance. Orthographic projection, no perspective, no elevated camera in side/front/back elevations. Flat uniform neutral grey background, absolutely no vignette. Clean cel-shaded technical illustration, flat even lighting, 2–3 tones per material, dark colored seam lines between plates. No text, labels or logos.

Preserve the current wolf exactly: long low lean charcoal/gunmetal segmented torso, vivid RED saddle/back armor patches and square red-bordered shoulder and hip plates with dark recessed centers; round red joint rings; long articulated SILVER GREY lower legs with exposed angular mechanical links, dark feet and red claws. Angular dark grey canine head, tapered blunt muzzle, thin cyan eyes, red forehead/brow and red teeth/fang accents. TWO upright ear blades close together on the head. Separately TWO thin red-tipped antenna rods, one on each side behind the ears, paired and parallel, not one centered joystick mast. Keep ears inside the paired antennas as the reference shows. No extra head masts. Heavy segmented mechanical tail sweeps back, with a row of large silver triangular spikes toward its end and a red end cap. Follow the exact silhouette, proportions, panel positions, tail length and reference hardware from every angle. Preserve anatomical left/right placements and visible asymmetric details; no invented cannons, wings, extra dorsal fins, organic fur or body changes. Cyan eye is flat color; NO glow, bloom, aura, or lighting effects. Do not use an earlier white-and-gold wolf design.
sprite_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Draw ONE superb finished GBA Zoids Legacy-style battle sprite of the exact mechanical wolf in the attached current eight-view sheet. Input image is the sole design reference. Full-body right-facing wolf, camera about 18 degrees above the ground and turned 20 degrees toward the viewer from a side view. Low lean long quadrupedal posture, four articulated legs and full spiked tail visible. Compose one horizontal sprite with ample margins on a completely flat uniform medium neutral grey background. One thin straight VIOLET ground line beneath its feet. No other views, text, labels, borders, scenery or logos.

Authentic deliberate pixel art: about 120 logical pixels tall, presented enlarged with crisp nearest-neighbor pixel edges. Target 30–35 colors arranged in long ramps, upper-left lighting, convincing metal through restrained highlight clusters, readable plate faces, selective single-pixel glints, exquisite orderly mechanical detail. Material-colored outlines darker than their own part, NEVER pure black. No antialiasing, blur, photorealism, smooth rendered surfaces, vignette, glow or bloom.

Follow THIS wolf's design exactly: long lean charcoal/gunmetal segmented torso; vivid RED saddle plates over the back, square red-bordered hip and shoulder plates with dark inset centers, red round joint rings; long SILVER GREY lower-leg armored mechanical links and exposed angular connectors, dark paws with RED claws. Angular dark grey canine head and tapered muzzle, red brow/forehead, thin flat cyan eyes, red fang accents. Exactly TWO upright ear blades next to one another on top of the head, inside TWO separately mounted thin red-tipped antenna rods, one each side behind the ears. Ears are inside the antennas; antennas are a paired parallel set, not one centered joystick mast. Match the original attachment's head silhouette, no additional masts. Long segmented dark grey mechanical tail with large triangular silver spikes toward the tail end and red terminal cap. Keep original proportions, armor segmentation, side panels and hardware placement. No new guns, wings, large back fins, fur, organic anatomy or redesign. Cyan eyes are flat colored pixel marks without emitted light. Make this a highly polished faithful game sprite reference of the user's machine.
